facts.title: Spaghetti Squash Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 2 medium spaghetti squash (about 2 pounds each), halved and seeds removed
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 cups purple cabbage, thinly sliced and roughly chopped into 2-inch long pieces
1 can (15 ounces) black beans, rinsed and drained
⅓ cup chopped green onions, both green and white parts
2 to 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice, to taste
¾ cup mild salsa verde, either homemade or store-bought
⅓ cup fresh cilantro (a few stems are ok)
Optional garnishes: chopped fresh cilantro, crumbled feta and/or toasted pepitas (not shown)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
